title: Campus Network Design & Simulation
description: Designed a multi-floor campus network topology using Cisco Packet Tracer. Implemented VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, OSPF, STP, and DHCP. Simulated full Layer 2/3 connectivity with redundant links.

title: AQI & Air Pollution Data Analysis
description: Analyzed air pollutant concentration datasets (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, CO) across Bangladesh. Built statistical models to identify AQI trends. Research presented at 8th IEOM Bangladesh International Conference.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Built this portfolio from scratch using Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4, and Framer Motion. Features a custom glassmorphism design system, dark/light mode, admin CMS backed by Vercel KV, and visitor analytics.
